shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,240p' next.config.ts && for f in pages/*.tsx; do echo \"FILE: "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f -maxdepth 5 | sort | rg '"'(app|migration|layout|metadata|link)' | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '292,440p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md && git status --short && git log -1 --oneline 2>/dev/null || true && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './.next/*' -printf '%p\\n' | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- app tsconfig.json pages && rg -n \"next/(head|app|document|router)|<a[[:space:]]+href=|pages/\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!.next/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' . || true && find app -type f -maxdepth 3 -print | sort && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' .gitignore && sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts && git diff --no-index /dev/null app/layout.tsx || true && git diff --no-index /dev/null app/page.tsx || true && git diff --no-index /dev/null app/about/page.tsx || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'for path in / /about; do curl --fail --silent --show-error "http://localhost:3000$path" | tr '"'>' '>\\n' | rg -o '["'^<]*|[''^<]*|href="/[''^"]*"'"' | sort -u; done"

/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && test ! -d pages && test -f app/layout.tsx && test -f app/page.tsx && test -f app/about/page.tsx && rg -n "next/(head|app|document|router)|<a[[:space:]]+href=" app || true'
